title: dactylorhiza lapponica subsp. angustata
intro: Dactylorhiza lapponica subsp. angustata, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Marsh Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the genus Dactylorhiza. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and heal various health conditions. The Narrow-leaved Marsh Orchid contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza lapponica subsp. angustata include wound healing, anti-inflammatory effects, and antimicrobial activity, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents.
